# Omre

> Omre is a longevity supplement company offering science-backed NAD+ boosters, senolytics, and metabolic health products for cellular aging support.

Omre specializes in premium, third-party tested longevity supplements including NMN, Resveratrol, Spermidine, Quercetin, and Berberine. The company emphasizes doctor-endorsed formulations and evidence-based approaches to cellular health and anti-aging.

## Key Topics

- NAD+ boosting
- NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide)
- Resveratrol
- Spermidine
- Quercetin + Fisetin (senolytics)
- Berberine (AMPK activator)
- Cellular autophagy
- Longevity supplements
- Third-party tested
- Bioavailability
- Dr. Pedram Kordrostami
- Anti-aging science
- Cellular energy
- Metabolic health
- Doctor-endorsed

## Core Products

- [NMN and Resveratrol Supplement](https://omre.co/products/nmn-resveratrol): Premium NMN + Resveratrol supplement for NAD+ cellular support.
- [Spermidine Supplement](https://omre.co/products/spermidine): Spermidine cellular autophagy activator from wheat germ extract.
- [Quercetin + Fisetin Supplement](https://omre.co/products/quercetin-fisetin): Quercetin and Fisetin senolytics for senescent cell management.
- [Berberine](https://omre.co/products/berberine): Berberine AMPK activator for blood sugar and metabolic health.
- [All Products](https://omre.co/collections/all-products): Complete catalog of Omre longevity supplements for healthy aging.
- [Bundle](https://omre.co/pages/bundle): Omre product bundle options with NMN, Spermidine, Quercetin, and Berberine.
